segments.name: Illinois Basin Coal Operations
segments.description: Produces thermal and metallurgical coal from four underground mining complexes in the Illinois Basin for domestic utilities, industrial customers and international buyers.
segments.evidence: The Illinois Basin Coal Operations reportable segment includes (a) the Gibson mining complex, (b) the Warrior mining complex, (c) the River View mining complex and (d) the Hamilton mining complex.

segments.name: Appalachia Coal Operations
segments.description: Produces coal from three Appalachian mining complexes for domestic utilities, industrial users and international customers.
segments.evidence: The Appalachia Coal Operations reportable segment includes (a) the Mettiki mining complex, (b) the Tunnel Ridge mining complex and (c) the MC Mining mining complex.

segments.name: Oil & Gas Royalties
segments.description: Owns oil and gas mineral and royalty interests and collects royalties and lease bonuses from operators developing them.
segments.evidence: The Oil & Gas Royalties reportable segment includes oil & gas mineral interests held by Alliance Minerals as well as our equity interests in AllDale III.

segments.name: Coal Royalties
segments.description: Leases coal mineral reserves and resources owned or leased by Alliance Resource Properties to mining complexes and others, earning coal royalties.
segments.evidence: The Coal Royalties reportable segment includes substantially all of our coal mineral resources and the majority of our coal mineral reserves owned or leased by Alliance Resource Properties.

revenueModel.text: Utilities, industrial customers and international buyers pay for coal, while operators pay royalties and lease bonuses for the mineral interests.
revenueModel.evidence: We market our coal production to major domestic and international utilities and industrial customers.
